hooks.text: 高速空战要求翻滚与冲刺穿过交汇弹幕，再以精确操作挑战神祇般的巨型Boss
hooks.excerpt: Engage in high-precision bullet-hell dogfighting: dash and roll through converging fire, unleash your firepower against relentless enemy waves, and face towering, God-like boss battles that push every run to its limit.

hooks.text: 三名驾驶员各有打法，玩家还要选择袭击补给线、要塞或被压迫世界，以具体行动扩大战争反抗
hooks.excerpt: Choose one of three Wind Runners, each with a distinct playstyle, and decide where to strike: disrupt enemy supply lines, destroy key fortresses, and free oppressed worlds. Each successful strike weakens the dominion, liberates a world and fuels the uprising!

hooks.text: 每次突袭收集的资源都会永久升级飞船、在母舰集结新盟友，并把失败转化为反抗军势力成长
hooks.excerpt: When a raid ends, gathered resources permanently upgrade your ship, rally new allies in your Mothership, and empower the resistance, turning defeat into momentum and bringing the resistance closer to victory.
